```rust
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::ui::Interaction;
use std::path::{PathBuf, Path};

/// アセットブラウザーのリソース
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct AssetBrowser {
    pub current_path: PathBuf,
    pub selected_asset: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub asset_files: Vec<AssetFileInfo>,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AssetFileInfo {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub name: String,
    pub asset_type: AssetType,
    pub is_directory: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetType {
    Mesh,
    Texture,
    Material,
    Script,
    Scene,
    Other,
}

impl AssetBrowser {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            current_path: PathBuf::from("assets"),
            selected_asset: None,
            asset_files: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
    
    pub fn scan_directory(&mut self) {
        self.asset_files.clear();
        
        if !self.current_path.exists() {
            return;
        }
        
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&self.current_path) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                let name = path.file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                    .to_string();
                
                let is_directory = path.is_dir();
                let asset_type = if is_directory {
                    AssetType::Other
                } else {
                    Self::detect_asset_type(&path)
                };
                
                self.asset_files.push(AssetFileInfo {
                    path,
                    name,
                    asset_type,
                    is_directory,
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 名前でソート
        self.asset_files.sort_by(|a, b| {
            // ディレクトリを先に
            match (a.is_directory, b.is_directory) {
                (true, false) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
                (false, true) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
                _ => a.name.cmp(&b.name),
            }
        });
    }
    
    fn detect_asset_type(path: &Path) -> AssetType {
        if let Some(ext) = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
            match ext.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "glb" | "gltf" | "obj" | "fbx" => AssetType::Mesh,
                "png" | "jpg" | "jpeg" | "bmp" | "tga" | "dds" => AssetType::Texture,
                "mat" | "material" => AssetType::Material,
                "lua" => AssetType::Script,
                "scene" | "scn" => AssetType::Scene,
                _ => AssetType::Other,
            }
        } else {
            AssetType::Other
        }
    }
}

impl Default for AssetBrowser {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのUI描画
pub fn draw_asset_browser(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    asset_browser_panel_query: Query<Entity, (With<Name>, With<Node>)>,
    name_query: Query<&Name>,
) {
    // アセットブラウザーパネルを検索
    let panel_opt = asset_browser_panel_query.iter().find(|&e| {
        if let Ok(name) = name_query.get(e) {
            name.as_str() == "AssetBrowserPanel"
        } else {
            false
        }
    });
    
    if let Some(panel) = panel_opt {
        // ディレクトリをスキャン
        asset_browser.scan_directory();
        
        // 既存のコンテンツを削除（簡易実装）
        // TODO: より効率的な方法で既存のコンテンツを管理
        
        let content_entity = commands.spawn((
            Node {
                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                overflow: Overflow::clip(),
                ..default()
            },
            Name::new("AssetBrowserContent"),
        )).with_children(|content| {
            // パス表示と戻るボタン
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    height: Val::Px(30.0),
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                    ..default()
                },
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)),
                Name::new("AssetBrowserPath"),
            )).with_children(|path_node| {
                // 戻るボタン（親ディレクトリがある場合のみ表示）
                if asset_browser.current_path.parent().is_some() {
                    path_node.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Px(60.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            margin: UiRect::right(Val::Px(5.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)),
                        Interaction::default(),
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserBackButton"),
                    )).with_children(|button| {
                        button.spawn((
                            Text::new("← Back"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 11.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                        ));
                    });
                }
                
                // パス表示
                path_node.spawn((
                    Node {
                        flex_grow: 1.0,
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                        align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                        padding: UiRect::left(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserPathText"),
                )).with_children(|path_text| {
                    path_text.spawn((
                        Text::new(asset_browser.current_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()),
                        bevy::text::TextFont {
                            font_size: 12.0,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                    ));
                });
            });
            
            // アセットリスト
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    flex_grow: 1.0,
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    overflow: Overflow::clip_y(),
                    ..default()
                },
                Name::new("AssetBrowserList"),
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)),
            )).with_children(|list| {
                for asset_file in &asset_browser.asset_files {
                    let is_selected = asset_browser.selected_asset.as_ref()
                        .map(|p| p == &asset_file.path)
                        .unwrap_or(false);
                    
                    let icon = if asset_file.is_directory {
                        "📁"
                    } else {
                        match asset_file.asset_type {
                            AssetType::Mesh => "🎲",
                            AssetType::Texture => "🖼️",
                            AssetType::Material => "🎨",
                            AssetType::Script => "📜",
                            AssetType::Scene => "🎬",
                            AssetType::Other => "📄",
                        }
                    };
                    
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                            padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(2.0)),
                            margin: UiRect::vertical(Val::Px(1.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new(format!("AssetItem_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        if is_selected {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.6))
                        } else {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::NONE)
                        },
                    )).with_children(|item| {
                        // アイコン
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Px(20.0),
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetIcon_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|icon_node| {
                            icon_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(icon),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 12.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                            ));
                        });
                        
                        // ファイル名
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetName_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|name_node| {
                            name_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(&asset_file.name),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 11.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(if is_selected {
                                    Color::srgb(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)

                                    Color::srgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)

                    });
                }
                
                if asset_browser.asset_files.is_empty() {
                    list.spawn((

                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserEmpty"),
                    )).with_children(|empty| {
                        empty.spawn((
                            Text::new("No assets found"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 12.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)),
                        ));
                    });
                }
            });
        }).id();
        
        commands.entity(panel).add_child(content_entity);
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのクリック処理
pub fn handle_asset_browser_click(
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    mouse_input: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>,
    interaction_query: Query<(&Interaction, &Name), Changed<Interaction>>,
) {
    if mouse_input.just_pressed(MouseButton::Left) {
        for (interaction, name) in interaction_query.iter() {
            if *interaction == Interaction::Pressed {
                let name_str = name.as_str();
                
                // アセットアイテムがクリックされた場合
                if name_str.starts_with("AssetItem_") {
                    let file_name = name_str.strip_prefix("AssetItem_").unwrap_or("");
                    
                    // アセットファイルを検索
                    if let Some(asset_file) = asset_browser.asset_files.iter()
                        .find(|f| f.name == file_name)
                    {
                        if asset_file.is_directory {
                            // ディレクトリの場合は移動
                            asset_browser.current_path = asset_file.path.clone();
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = None;
                        } else {
                            // ファイルの場合は選択
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = Some(asset_file.path.clone());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

```rust
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::ui::Interaction;
use std::path::{PathBuf, Path};

/// アセットブラウザーのリソース
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct AssetBrowser {
    pub current_path: PathBuf,
    pub selected_asset: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub asset_files: Vec<AssetFileInfo>,
    pub content_entity: Option<Entity>, // 現在のコンテンツエンティティ（再描画の最適化用）
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AssetFileInfo {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub name: String,
    pub asset_type: AssetType,
    pub is_directory: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetType {
    Mesh,
    Texture,
    Material,
    Script,
    Scene,
    Other,
}

impl AssetBrowser {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            current_path: PathBuf::from("assets"),
            selected_asset: None,
            asset_files: Vec::new(),
        }
    }
    
    pub fn scan_directory(&mut self) {
        self.asset_files.clear();
        
        if !self.current_path.exists() {
            return;
        }
        
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&self.current_path) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                let name = path.file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                    .to_string();
                
                let is_directory = path.is_dir();
                let asset_type = if is_directory {
                    AssetType::Other
                } else {
                    Self::detect_asset_type(&path)
                };
                
                self.asset_files.push(AssetFileInfo {
                    path,
                    name,
                    asset_type,
                    is_directory,
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 名前でソート
        self.asset_files.sort_by(|a, b| {
            // ディレクトリを先に
            match (a.is_directory, b.is_directory) {
                (true, false) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
                (false, true) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
                _ => a.name.cmp(&b.name),
            }
        });
    }
    
    fn detect_asset_type(path: &Path) -> AssetType {
        if let Some(ext) = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
            match ext.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "glb" | "gltf" | "obj" | "fbx" => AssetType::Mesh,
                "png" | "jpg" | "jpeg" | "bmp" | "tga" | "dds" => AssetType::Texture,
                "mat" | "material" => AssetType::Material,
                "lua" => AssetType::Script,
                "scene" | "scn" => AssetType::Scene,
                _ => AssetType::Other,
            }
        } else {
            AssetType::Other
        }
    }
}

impl Default for AssetBrowser {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのUI描画
pub fn draw_asset_browser(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    asset_browser_panel_query: Query<Entity, (With<Name>, With<Node>)>,
    name_query: Query<&Name>,
) {
    // アセットブラウザーパネルを検索
    let panel_opt = asset_browser_panel_query.iter().find(|&e| {
        if let Ok(name) = name_query.get(e) {
            name.as_str() == "AssetBrowserPanel"
        } else {
            false
        }
    });
    
    if let Some(panel) = panel_opt {
        // ディレクトリをスキャン
        asset_browser.scan_directory();
        
        // 既存のコンテンツを削除（簡易実装）
        // TODO: より効率的な方法で既存のコンテンツを管理
        
        let content_entity = commands.spawn((
            Node {
                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                overflow: Overflow::clip(),
                ..default()
            },
            Name::new("AssetBrowserContent"),
        )).with_children(|content| {
            // パス表示と戻るボタン
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    height: Val::Px(30.0),
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                    ..default()
                },
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)),
                Name::new("AssetBrowserPath"),
            )).with_children(|path_node| {
                // 戻るボタン（親ディレクトリがある場合のみ表示）
                if asset_browser.current_path.parent().is_some() {
                    path_node.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Px(60.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            margin: UiRect::right(Val::Px(5.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)),
                        Interaction::default(),
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserBackButton"),
                    )).with_children(|button| {
                        button.spawn((
                            Text::new("← Back"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 11.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                        ));
                    });
                }
                
                // パス表示
                path_node.spawn((
                    Node {
                        flex_grow: 1.0,
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                        align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                        padding: UiRect::left(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserPathText"),
                )).with_children(|path_text| {
                    path_text.spawn((
                        Text::new(asset_browser.current_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()),
                        bevy::text::TextFont {
                            font_size: 12.0,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                    ));
                });
            });
            
            // アセットリスト
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    flex_grow: 1.0,
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    overflow: Overflow::clip_y(),
                    ..default()
                },
                Name::new("AssetBrowserList"),
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)),
            )).with_children(|list| {
                for asset_file in &asset_browser.asset_files {
                    let is_selected = asset_browser.selected_asset.as_ref()
                        .map(|p| p == &asset_file.path)
                        .unwrap_or(false);
                    
                    let icon = if asset_file.is_directory {
                        "📁"
                    } else {
                        match asset_file.asset_type {
                            AssetType::Mesh => "🎲",
                            AssetType::Texture => "🖼️",
                            AssetType::Material => "🎨",
                            AssetType::Script => "📜",
                            AssetType::Scene => "🎬",
                            AssetType::Other => "📄",
                        }
                    };
                    
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                            padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(2.0)),
                            margin: UiRect::vertical(Val::Px(1.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new(format!("AssetItem_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        if is_selected {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.6))
                        } else {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::NONE)
                        },
                    )).with_children(|item| {
                        // アイコン
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Px(20.0),
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetIcon_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|icon_node| {
                            icon_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(icon),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 12.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                            ));
                        });
                        
                        // ファイル名
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetName_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|name_node| {
                            name_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(&asset_file.name),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 11.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(if is_selected {
                                    Color::srgb(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
                                } else {
                                    Color::srgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
                                }),
                            ));
                        });
                    });
                }
                
                if asset_browser.asset_files.is_empty() {
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(30.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserEmpty"),
                    )).with_children(|empty| {
                        empty.spawn((
                            Text::new("No assets found"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 12.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)),
                        ));
                    });
                }
            });
        }).id();
        
        commands.entity(panel).add_child(content_entity);
    }
}

pub fn handle_asset_browser_click(

```rust
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::ui::Interaction;
use std::path::{PathBuf, Path};

/// アセットブラウザーのリソース
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct AssetBrowser {
    pub current_path: PathBuf,
    pub selected_asset: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub asset_files: Vec<AssetFileInfo>,
    pub content_entity: Option<Entity>, // 現在のコンテンツエンティティ（再描画の最適化用）
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AssetFileInfo {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub name: String,
    pub asset_type: AssetType,
    pub is_directory: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetType {
    Mesh,
    Texture,
    Material,
    Script,
    Scene,
    Other,
}

impl AssetBrowser {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            current_path: PathBuf::from("assets"),
            selected_asset: None,
            asset_files: Vec::new(),
            content_entity: None,
        }
    }
    
    pub fn scan_directory(&mut self) {
        self.asset_files.clear();
        
        if !self.current_path.exists() {
            return;
        }
        
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&self.current_path) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                let name = path.file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                    .to_string();
                
                let is_directory = path.is_dir();
                let asset_type = if is_directory {
                    AssetType::Other
                } else {
                    Self::detect_asset_type(&path)
                };
                
                self.asset_files.push(AssetFileInfo {
                    path,
                    name,
                    asset_type,
                    is_directory,
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 名前でソート
        self.asset_files.sort_by(|a, b| {
            // ディレクトリを先に
            match (a.is_directory, b.is_directory) {
                (true, false) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
                (false, true) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
                _ => a.name.cmp(&b.name),
            }
        });
    }
    
    fn detect_asset_type(path: &Path) -> AssetType {
        if let Some(ext) = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
            match ext.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "glb" | "gltf" | "obj" | "fbx" => AssetType::Mesh,
                "png" | "jpg" | "jpeg" | "bmp" | "tga" | "dds" => AssetType::Texture,
                "mat" | "material" => AssetType::Material,
                "lua" => AssetType::Script,
                "scene" | "scn" => AssetType::Scene,
                _ => AssetType::Other,
            }
        } else {
            AssetType::Other
        }
    }
}

impl Default for AssetBrowser {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのUI描画
pub fn draw_asset_browser(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    asset_browser_panel_query: Query<Entity, (With<Name>, With<Node>)>,
    name_query: Query<&Name>,
) {
    // アセットブラウザーパネルを検索
    let panel_opt = asset_browser_panel_query.iter().find(|&e| {
        if let Ok(name) = name_query.get(e) {
            name.as_str() == "AssetBrowserPanel"
        } else {
            false
        }
    });
    
    if let Some(panel) = panel_opt {
        // 既存のコンテンツを削除
        if let Some(content_entity) = asset_browser.content_entity {
            if let Ok(mut entity_commands) = commands.get_entity(content_entity) {
                entity_commands.despawn();
            }
        }
        
        // ディレクトリをスキャン
        asset_browser.scan_directory();
        
        let content_entity = commands.spawn((
            Node {
                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                overflow: Overflow::clip(),
                ..default()
            },
            Name::new("AssetBrowserContent"),
        )).with_children(|content| {
            // パス表示と戻るボタン
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    height: Val::Px(30.0),
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                    ..default()
                },
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)),
                Name::new("AssetBrowserPath"),
            )).with_children(|path_node| {
                // 戻るボタン（親ディレクトリがある場合のみ表示）
                if asset_browser.current_path.parent().is_some() {
                    path_node.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Px(60.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            margin: UiRect::right(Val::Px(5.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)),
                        Interaction::default(),
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserBackButton"),
                    )).with_children(|button| {
                        button.spawn((
                            Text::new("← Back"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 11.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                        ));
                    });
                }
                
                // パス表示
                path_node.spawn((
                    Node {
                        flex_grow: 1.0,
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                        align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                        padding: UiRect::left(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserPathText"),
                )).with_children(|path_text| {
                    path_text.spawn((
                        Text::new(asset_browser.current_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()),
                        bevy::text::TextFont {
                            font_size: 12.0,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                    ));
                });
            });
            
            // アセットリスト
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    flex_grow: 1.0,
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    overflow: Overflow::clip_y(),
                    ..default()
                },
                Name::new("AssetBrowserList"),
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)),
            )).with_children(|list| {
                for asset_file in &asset_browser.asset_files {
                    let is_selected = asset_browser.selected_asset.as_ref()
                        .map(|p| p == &asset_file.path)
                        .unwrap_or(false);
                    
                    let icon = if asset_file.is_directory {
                        "📁"
                    } else {
                        match asset_file.asset_type {
                            AssetType::Mesh => "🎲",
                            AssetType::Texture => "🖼️",
                            AssetType::Material => "🎨",
                            AssetType::Script => "📜",
                            AssetType::Scene => "🎬",
                            AssetType::Other => "📄",
                        }
                    };
                    
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                            padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(2.0)),
                            margin: UiRect::vertical(Val::Px(1.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new(format!("AssetItem_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        if is_selected {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.6))
                        } else {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::NONE)
                        },
                    )).with_children(|item| {
                        // アイコン
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Px(20.0),
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetIcon_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|icon_node| {
                            icon_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(icon),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 12.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                            ));
                        });
                        
                        // ファイル名
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetName_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|name_node| {
                            name_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(&asset_file.name),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 11.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(if is_selected {
                                    Color::srgb(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
                                } else {
                                    Color::srgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
                                }),
                            ));
                        });
                    });
                }
                
                if asset_browser.asset_files.is_empty() {
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(30.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserEmpty"),
                    )).with_children(|empty| {
                        empty.spawn((
                            Text::new("No assets found"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 12.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)),
                        ));
                    });
                }
            });
        }).id();
        
        commands.entity(panel).add_child(content_entity);
    }
}

                        } else {
                            // ファイルの場合は選択
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = Some(asset_file.path.clone());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

```rust
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::ui::Interaction;
use std::path::{PathBuf, Path};

/// アセットブラウザーのリソース
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct AssetBrowser {
    pub current_path: PathBuf,
    pub selected_asset: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub asset_files: Vec<AssetFileInfo>,
    pub content_entity: Option<Entity>, // 現在のコンテンツエンティティ（再描画の最適化用）
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AssetFileInfo {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub name: String,
    pub asset_type: AssetType,
    pub is_directory: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetType {
    Mesh,
    Texture,
    Material,
    Script,
    Scene,
    Other,
}

impl AssetBrowser {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            current_path: PathBuf::from("assets"),
            selected_asset: None,
            asset_files: Vec::new(),
            content_entity: None,
        }
    }
    
    pub fn scan_directory(&mut self) {
        self.asset_files.clear();
        
        if !self.current_path.exists() {
            return;
        }
        
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&self.current_path) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                let name = path.file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                    .to_string();
                
                let is_directory = path.is_dir();
                let asset_type = if is_directory {
                    AssetType::Other
                } else {
                    Self::detect_asset_type(&path)
                };
                
                self.asset_files.push(AssetFileInfo {
                    path,
                    name,
                    asset_type,
                    is_directory,
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 名前でソート
        self.asset_files.sort_by(|a, b| {
            // ディレクトリを先に
            match (a.is_directory, b.is_directory) {
                (true, false) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
                (false, true) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
                _ => a.name.cmp(&b.name),
            }
        });
    }
    
    fn detect_asset_type(path: &Path) -> AssetType {
        if let Some(ext) = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
            match ext.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "glb" | "gltf" | "obj" | "fbx" => AssetType::Mesh,
                "png" | "jpg" | "jpeg" | "bmp" | "tga" | "dds" => AssetType::Texture,
                "mat" | "material" => AssetType::Material,
                "lua" => AssetType::Script,
                "scene" | "scn" => AssetType::Scene,
                _ => AssetType::Other,
            }
        } else {
            AssetType::Other
        }
    }
}

impl Default for AssetBrowser {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのUI描画
pub fn draw_asset_browser(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    asset_browser_panel_query: Query<Entity, (With<Name>, With<Node>)>,
    name_query: Query<&Name>,
) {
    // アセットブラウザーパネルを検索
    let panel_opt = asset_browser_panel_query.iter().find(|&e| {
        if let Ok(name) = name_query.get(e) {
            name.as_str() == "AssetBrowserPanel"
        } else {
            false
        }
    });
    
    if let Some(panel) = panel_opt {
        // 既存のコンテンツを削除
        if let Some(content_entity) = asset_browser.content_entity {
            if let Ok(mut entity_commands) = commands.get_entity(content_entity) {
                entity_commands.despawn();
            }
        }
        
        // ディレクトリをスキャン
        asset_browser.scan_directory();
        
        let content_entity = commands.spawn((
            Node {
                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                overflow: Overflow::clip(),
                ..default()
            },
            Name::new("AssetBrowserContent"),
        )).with_children(|content| {
            // パス表示と戻るボタン
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    height: Val::Px(30.0),
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                    ..default()
                },
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)),
                Name::new("AssetBrowserPath"),
            )).with_children(|path_node| {
                // 戻るボタン（親ディレクトリがある場合のみ表示）
                if asset_browser.current_path.parent().is_some() {
                    path_node.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Px(60.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            margin: UiRect::right(Val::Px(5.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)),
                        Interaction::default(),
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserBackButton"),
                    )).with_children(|button| {
                        button.spawn((
                            Text::new("← Back"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 11.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                        ));
                    });
                }
                
                // パス表示
                path_node.spawn((
                    Node {
                        flex_grow: 1.0,
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                        align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                        padding: UiRect::left(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserPathText"),
                )).with_children(|path_text| {
                    path_text.spawn((
                        Text::new(asset_browser.current_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()),
                        bevy::text::TextFont {
                            font_size: 12.0,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                    ));
                });
            });
            
            // アセットリスト
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    flex_grow: 1.0,
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    overflow: Overflow::clip_y(),
                    ..default()
                },
                Name::new("AssetBrowserList"),
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)),
            )).with_children(|list| {
                for asset_file in &asset_browser.asset_files {
                    let is_selected = asset_browser.selected_asset.as_ref()
                        .map(|p| p == &asset_file.path)
                        .unwrap_or(false);
                    
                    let icon = if asset_file.is_directory {
                        "📁"
                    } else {
                        match asset_file.asset_type {
                            AssetType::Mesh => "🎲",
                            AssetType::Texture => "🖼️",
                            AssetType::Material => "🎨",
                            AssetType::Script => "📜",
                            AssetType::Scene => "🎬",
                            AssetType::Other => "📄",
                        }
                    };
                    
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                            padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(2.0)),
                            margin: UiRect::vertical(Val::Px(1.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new(format!("AssetItem_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        if is_selected {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.6))
                        } else {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::NONE)
                        },
                    )).with_children(|item| {
                        // アイコン
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Px(20.0),
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetIcon_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|icon_node| {
                            icon_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(icon),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 12.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                            ));
                        });
                        
                        // ファイル名
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetName_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|name_node| {
                            name_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(&asset_file.name),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 11.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(if is_selected {
                                    Color::srgb(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
                                } else {
                                    Color::srgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
                                }),
                            ));
                        });
                    });
                }
                
                if asset_browser.asset_files.is_empty() {
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(30.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserEmpty"),
                    )).with_children(|empty| {
                        empty.spawn((
                            Text::new("No assets found"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 12.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)),
                        ));
                    });
                }
                });
                
                // プレビューパネル
                main_container.spawn((
                    Node {
                        width: Val::Percent(40.0),
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                        padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserPreview"),
                    BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.12, 0.12, 0.12)),
                )).with_children(|preview| {
                    // プレビューヘッダー
                    preview.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(25.0),
                            padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserPreviewHeader"),
                    )).with_children(|header| {
                        header.spawn((
                            Text::new("Preview"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 12.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                        ));
                    });
                    
                    // プレビューコンテンツ
                    if let Some(selected_path) = &asset_browser.selected_asset {
                        let preview_text = if let Some(asset_file) = asset_browser.asset_files.iter()
                            .find(|f| f.path == *selected_path)
                        {
                            match asset_file.asset_type {
                                AssetType::Mesh => format!("Mesh: {}\n\n3Dモデルファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Texture => format!("Texture: {}\n\n画像ファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Material => format!("Material: {}\n\nマテリアルファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Script => format!("Script: {}\n\nLuaスクリプトファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Scene => format!("Scene: {}\n\nシーンファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Other => format!("File: {}\n\nその他のファイル", asset_file.name),
                            }
                        } else {
                            "選択されたアセットが見つかりません".to_string()
                        };
                        
                        preview.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(10.0)),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                                align_items: AlignItems::FlexStart,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new("AssetBrowserPreviewContent"),
                        )).with_children(|preview_content| {
                            preview_content.spawn((
                                Text::new(&preview_text),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 11.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)),
                            ));
                        });
                    } else {
                        preview.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new("AssetBrowserPreviewEmpty"),
                        )).with_children(|empty| {
                            empty.spawn((
                                Text::new("アセットを選択してください"),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 12.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)),
                            ));
                        });
                    }
                });
            });
        }).id();
        
        commands.entity(panel).add_child(content_entity);
        asset_browser.content_entity = Some(content_entity);
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのクリック処理
pub fn handle_asset_browser_click(
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    mouse_input: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>,
    interaction_query: Query<(&Interaction, &Name), Changed<Interaction>>,
) {
    if mouse_input.just_pressed(MouseButton::Left) {
        for (interaction, name) in interaction_query.iter() {
            if *interaction == Interaction::Pressed {
                let name_str = name.as_str();
                
                // アセットアイテムがクリックされた場合
                if name_str.starts_with("AssetItem_") {
                    let file_name = name_str.strip_prefix("AssetItem_").unwrap_or("");
                    
                    // アセットファイルを検索
                    if let Some(asset_file) = asset_browser.asset_files.iter()
                        .find(|f| f.name == file_name)
                    {
                        if asset_file.is_directory {
                            // ディレクトリの場合は移動
                            asset_browser.current_path = asset_file.path.clone();
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = None;
                        } else {
                            // ファイルの場合は選択
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = Some(asset_file.path.clone());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのクリック処理
pub fn handle_asset_browser_click(
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    mouse_input: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>,
    interaction_query: Query<(&Interaction, &Name), Changed<Interaction>>,
) {
    if mouse_input.just_pressed(MouseButton::Left) {
        for (interaction, name) in interaction_query.iter() {
            if *interaction == Interaction::Pressed {
                let name_str = name.as_str();
                
                // アセットアイテムがクリックされた場合
                if name_str.starts_with("AssetItem_") {
                    let file_name = name_str.strip_prefix("AssetItem_").unwrap_or("");
                    
                    // アセットファイルを検索
                    if let Some(asset_file) = asset_browser.asset_files.iter()
                        .find(|f| f.name == file_name)
                    {
                        if asset_file.is_directory {
                            // ディレクトリの場合は移動
                            asset_browser.current_path = asset_file.path.clone();
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = None;
                        } else {
                            // ファイルの場合は選択
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = Some(asset_file.path.clone());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

```rust
use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::ui::Interaction;
use std::path::{PathBuf, Path};

/// アセットブラウザーのリソース
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct AssetBrowser {
    pub current_path: PathBuf,
    pub selected_asset: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub asset_files: Vec<AssetFileInfo>,
    pub content_entity: Option<Entity>, // 現在のコンテンツエンティティ（再描画の最適化用）
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AssetFileInfo {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub name: String,
    pub asset_type: AssetType,
    pub is_directory: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetType {
    Mesh,
    Texture,
    Material,
    Script,
    Scene,
    Other,
}

impl AssetBrowser {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            current_path: PathBuf::from("assets"),
            selected_asset: None,
            asset_files: Vec::new(),
            content_entity: None,
        }
    }
    
    pub fn scan_directory(&mut self) {
        self.asset_files.clear();
        
        if !self.current_path.exists() {
            return;
        }
        
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&self.current_path) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                let name = path.file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                    .to_string();
                
                let is_directory = path.is_dir();
                let asset_type = if is_directory {
                    AssetType::Other
                } else {
                    Self::detect_asset_type(&path)
                };
                
                self.asset_files.push(AssetFileInfo {
                    path,
                    name,
                    asset_type,
                    is_directory,
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 名前でソート
        self.asset_files.sort_by(|a, b| {
            // ディレクトリを先に
            match (a.is_directory, b.is_directory) {
                (true, false) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
                (false, true) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
                _ => a.name.cmp(&b.name),
            }
        });
    }
    
    fn detect_asset_type(path: &Path) -> AssetType {
        if let Some(ext) = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
            match ext.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "glb" | "gltf" | "obj" | "fbx" => AssetType::Mesh,
                "png" | "jpg" | "jpeg" | "bmp" | "tga" | "dds" => AssetType::Texture,
                "mat" | "material" => AssetType::Material,
                "lua" => AssetType::Script,
                "scene" | "scn" => AssetType::Scene,
                _ => AssetType::Other,
            }
        } else {
            AssetType::Other
        }
    }
}

impl Default for AssetBrowser {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのUI描画
pub fn draw_asset_browser(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,

    name_query: Query<&Name>,
) {
    // アセットブラウザーパネルを検索
    let panel_opt = asset_browser_panel_query.iter().find(|&e| {
        if let Ok(name) = name_query.get(e) {
            name.as_str() == "AssetBrowserPanel"
        } else {

    if let Some(panel) = panel_opt {

                entity_commands.despawn();

        // ディレクトリをスキャン
        asset_browser.scan_directory();

use bevy::prelude::*;
use bevy::ui::Interaction;
use std::path::{PathBuf, Path};

/// アセットブラウザーのリソース
#[derive(Resource)]
pub struct AssetBrowser {
    pub current_path: PathBuf,
    pub selected_asset: Option<PathBuf>,
    pub asset_files: Vec<AssetFileInfo>,
    pub content_entity: Option<Entity>, // 現在のコンテンツエンティティ（再描画の最適化用）
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct AssetFileInfo {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub name: String,
    pub asset_type: AssetType,
    pub is_directory: bool,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AssetType {
    Mesh,
    Texture,
    Material,
    Script,
    Scene,
    Other,
}

impl AssetBrowser {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            current_path: PathBuf::from("assets"),
            selected_asset: None,
            asset_files: Vec::new(),
            content_entity: None,
        }
    }
    
    pub fn scan_directory(&mut self) {
        self.asset_files.clear();
        
        if !self.current_path.exists() {
            return;
        }
        
        if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&self.current_path) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let path = entry.path();
                let name = path.file_name()
                    .and_then(|n| n.to_str())
                    .unwrap_or("Unknown")
                    .to_string();
                
                let is_directory = path.is_dir();
                let asset_type = if is_directory {
                    AssetType::Other
                } else {
                    Self::detect_asset_type(&path)
                };
                
                self.asset_files.push(AssetFileInfo {
                    path,
                    name,
                    asset_type,
                    is_directory,
                });
            }
        }
        
        // 名前でソート
        self.asset_files.sort_by(|a, b| {
            // ディレクトリを先に
            match (a.is_directory, b.is_directory) {
                (true, false) => std::cmp::Ordering::Less,
                (false, true) => std::cmp::Ordering::Greater,
                _ => a.name.cmp(&b.name),
            }
        });
    }
    
    fn detect_asset_type(path: &Path) -> AssetType {
        if let Some(ext) = path.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
            match ext.to_lowercase().as_str() {
                "glb" | "gltf" | "obj" | "fbx" => AssetType::Mesh,
                "png" | "jpg" | "jpeg" | "bmp" | "tga" | "dds" => AssetType::Texture,
                "mat" | "material" => AssetType::Material,
                "lua" => AssetType::Script,
                "scene" | "scn" => AssetType::Scene,
                _ => AssetType::Other,
            }
        } else {
            AssetType::Other
        }
    }
}

impl Default for AssetBrowser {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self::new()
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのUI描画
pub fn draw_asset_browser(
    mut commands: Commands,
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    asset_browser_panel_query: Query<Entity, (With<Name>, With<Node>)>,
    name_query: Query<&Name>,
) {
    // アセットブラウザーパネルを検索
    let panel_opt = asset_browser_panel_query.iter().find(|&e| {
        if let Ok(name) = name_query.get(e) {
            name.as_str() == "AssetBrowserPanel"
        } else {
            false
        }
    });
    
    if let Some(panel) = panel_opt {
        // 既存のコンテンツを削除
        if let Some(content_entity) = asset_browser.content_entity {
            if let Ok(mut entity_commands) = commands.get_entity(content_entity) {
                entity_commands.despawn();
            }
        }
        
        // ディレクトリをスキャン
        asset_browser.scan_directory();
        
        let content_entity = commands.spawn((
            Node {
                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                overflow: Overflow::clip(),
                ..default()
            },
            Name::new("AssetBrowserContent"),
        )).with_children(|content| {
            // パス表示と戻るボタン
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    height: Val::Px(30.0),
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                    ..default()
                },
                BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)),
                Name::new("AssetBrowserPath"),
            )).with_children(|path_node| {
                // 戻るボタン（親ディレクトリがある場合のみ表示）
                if asset_browser.current_path.parent().is_some() {
                    path_node.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Px(60.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            margin: UiRect::right(Val::Px(5.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.3, 0.3, 0.3)),
                        Interaction::default(),
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserBackButton"),
                    )).with_children(|button| {
                        button.spawn((
                            Text::new("← Back"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 11.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                        ));
                    });
                }
                
                // パス表示
                path_node.spawn((
                    Node {
                        flex_grow: 1.0,
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                        align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                        padding: UiRect::left(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserPathText"),
                )).with_children(|path_text| {
                    path_text.spawn((
                        Text::new(asset_browser.current_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()),
                        bevy::text::TextFont {
                            font_size: 12.0,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                    ));
                });
            });
            
            // アセットリストとプレビューのコンテナ
            content.spawn((
                Node {
                    width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                    flex_grow: 1.0,
                    flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                    padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                    ..default()
                },
                Name::new("AssetBrowserMainContainer"),
            )).with_children(|main_container| {
                // アセットリスト
                main_container.spawn((
                    Node {
                        width: Val::Percent(60.0),
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                        padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        overflow: Overflow::clip_y(),
                        margin: UiRect::right(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserList"),
                    BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)),
                )).with_children(|list| {
                for asset_file in &asset_browser.asset_files {
                    let is_selected = asset_browser.selected_asset.as_ref()
                        .map(|p| p == &asset_file.path)
                        .unwrap_or(false);
                    
                    let icon = if asset_file.is_directory {
                        "📁"
                    } else {
                        match asset_file.asset_type {
                            AssetType::Mesh => "🎲",
                            AssetType::Texture => "🖼️",
                            AssetType::Material => "🎨",
                            AssetType::Script => "📜",
                            AssetType::Scene => "🎬",
                            AssetType::Other => "📄",
                        }
                    };
                    
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(20.0),
                            flex_direction: FlexDirection::Row,
                            padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(2.0)),
                            margin: UiRect::vertical(Val::Px(1.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new(format!("AssetItem_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        if is_selected {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.2, 0.4, 0.6))
                        } else {
                            BackgroundColor(Color::NONE)
                        },
                    )).with_children(|item| {
                        // アイコン
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Px(20.0),
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetIcon_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|icon_node| {
                            icon_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(icon),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 12.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                            ));
                        });
                        
                        // ファイル名
                        item.spawn((
                            Node {
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new(format!("AssetName_{}", asset_file.name)),
                        )).with_children(|name_node| {
                            name_node.spawn((
                                Text::new(&asset_file.name),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 11.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(if is_selected {
                                    Color::srgb(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
                                } else {
                                    Color::srgb(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
                                }),
                            ));
                        });
                    });
                }
                
                if asset_browser.asset_files.is_empty() {
                    list.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(30.0),
                            justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                            align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserEmpty"),
                    )).with_children(|empty| {
                        empty.spawn((
                            Text::new("No assets found"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 12.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)),
                        ));
                    });
                }
                });
                
                // プレビューパネル
                main_container.spawn((
                    Node {
                        width: Val::Percent(40.0),
                        height: Val::Percent(100.0),
                        flex_direction: FlexDirection::Column,
                        padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                        ..default()
                    },
                    Name::new("AssetBrowserPreview"),
                    BackgroundColor(Color::srgb(0.12, 0.12, 0.12)),
                )).with_children(|preview| {
                    // プレビューヘッダー
                    preview.spawn((
                        Node {
                            width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                            height: Val::Px(25.0),
                            padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(5.0)),
                            ..default()
                        },
                        Name::new("AssetBrowserPreviewHeader"),
                    )).with_children(|header| {
                        header.spawn((
                            Text::new("Preview"),
                            bevy::text::TextFont {
                                font_size: 12.0,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            bevy::text::TextColor(Color::WHITE),
                        ));
                    });
                    
                    // プレビューコンテンツ
                    if let Some(selected_path) = &asset_browser.selected_asset {
                        let preview_text = if let Some(asset_file) = asset_browser.asset_files.iter()
                            .find(|f| f.path == *selected_path)
                        {
                            match asset_file.asset_type {
                                AssetType::Mesh => format!("Mesh: {}\n\n3Dモデルファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Texture => format!("Texture: {}\n\n画像ファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Material => format!("Material: {}\n\nマテリアルファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Script => format!("Script: {}\n\nLuaスクリプトファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Scene => format!("Scene: {}\n\nシーンファイル", asset_file.name),
                                AssetType::Other => format!("File: {}\n\nその他のファイル", asset_file.name),
                            }
                        } else {
                            "選択されたアセットが見つかりません".to_string()
                        };
                        
                        preview.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                padding: UiRect::all(Val::Px(10.0)),
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::FlexStart,
                                align_items: AlignItems::FlexStart,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new("AssetBrowserPreviewContent"),
                        )).with_children(|preview_content| {
                            preview_content.spawn((
                                Text::new(&preview_text),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 11.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.8, 0.8, 0.8)),
                            ));
                        });
                    } else {
                        preview.spawn((
                            Node {
                                width: Val::Percent(100.0),
                                flex_grow: 1.0,
                                justify_content: JustifyContent::Center,
                                align_items: AlignItems::Center,
                                ..default()
                            },
                            Name::new("AssetBrowserPreviewEmpty"),
                        )).with_children(|empty| {
                            empty.spawn((
                                Text::new("アセットを選択してください"),
                                bevy::text::TextFont {
                                    font_size: 12.0,
                                    ..default()
                                },
                                bevy::text::TextColor(Color::srgb(0.6, 0.6, 0.6)),
                            ));
                        });
                    }
                });
            });
        }).id();
        
        commands.entity(panel).add_child(content_entity);
        asset_browser.content_entity = Some(content_entity);
    }
}

/// アセットブラウザーのクリック処理
pub fn handle_asset_browser_click(
    mut asset_browser: ResMut<AssetBrowser>,
    mouse_input: Res<ButtonInput<MouseButton>>,
    interaction_query: Query<(&Interaction, &Name), Changed<Interaction>>,
) {
    if mouse_input.just_pressed(MouseButton::Left) {
        for (interaction, name) in interaction_query.iter() {
            if *interaction == Interaction::Pressed {
                let name_str = name.as_str();
                
                // アセットアイテムがクリックされた場合
                if name_str.starts_with("AssetItem_") {
                    let file_name = name_str.strip_prefix("AssetItem_").unwrap_or("");
                    
                    // アセットファイルを検索
                    if let Some(asset_file) = asset_browser.asset_files.iter()
                        .find(|f| f.name == file_name)
                    {
                        if asset_file.is_directory {
                            // ディレクトリの場合は移動
                            asset_browser.current_path = asset_file.path.clone();
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = None;
                        } else {
                            // ファイルの場合は選択
                            asset_browser.selected_asset = Some(asset_file.path.clone());
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
